processing_attempt.reason: Changed zbroya lettering and small surface/propeller details despite an explicit preserve-original request. Do not publish or count the generated output.

next_processing_requirement: Pixel-preserving photographic masking and conservative enhancement; verify output against source. Do not regenerate hidden or unclear structures.
publication_attribution_requirement: Before importing a CC BY photo, add visible author/publisher/source/license/change credits in the app. An attribution URL is not a runtime photo loader.
